dailyInsight.headline: Check Goose recipes that expect a background task handle
dailyInsight.insight: Goose has merged removal of its detached subagent interface while retaining concurrent foreground helpers. Recipes that start work and collect it in a later turn depend on a different contract from recipes that only need parallel work.
dailyInsight.mechanism: The October 7 Summon change removes async task handles and later collection through load, including its peek and cancel arguments. October 5 foreground machinery runs pending children concurrently and delivers their outcomes through the parent session; the legacy loop returns results directly.
dailyInsight.whyItMatters: A recipe can retain an old async argument without preserving its detached behavior. Authors need to check result delivery and the next step, not only whether the call parses.

actions.audience: Authors maintaining Goose recipes or integrations
actions.label: Review detached-work assumptions before upgrading
actions.instruction: In a disposable copy, identify instructions using async delegation and later task-ID collection. Compare them with the revised upstream batch example, then test completion and interruption against a version containing the change before updating the real workflow.
actions.effort: One recipe review and a bounded test when a containing version is available

receipts.title: Detached delegation interface removed on main
receipts.supports: Removes background task handles, task collection and the hidden orchestrator while retaining foreground delegation.

receipts.title: Foreground state-machine subagents added
receipts.supports: Establishes the replacement path, including concurrent child execution and session-level outcome delivery.

receipts.title: Revised concurrency and completion self-test
receipts.supports: Defines concurrent batched delegates and bounded completion scenarios; these are inspected instructions, not independently executed results.

confidence.basis: Pinned implementation, public review and test definitions were inspected, including distinct legacy and state-machine delivery paths.

dailyInsight.limitation: This is merged development source, not a containing release or installed-version guarantee. Goose and its model-driven tests were not executed. No reliability or speed improvement is claimed; foreground child-session IDs still exist.
dailyInsight.falsifier: A containing release that retains the detached task collection interface, or a reproducible trace showing batched foreground children cannot overlap, would change the migration advice.
dailyInsight.watchNext: A containing release and a recipe trace that demonstrates concurrent completion, interruption and migration from task-ID collection.
